Easy Hummus
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, February 12, 2010 - 12:22am

Ingredients




1 can Chick peas
2 Cloves of garlic
3 tablespoons Lemon juice
4 tablespoons Tahini (sesame seed paste)

Preparation

1 Drain half the liquid out of the can of chick peas. Put all the ingredients into a mixers and mix on high, stirring occasionally until it is a creamy, paste consistency. 2 Makes a wonderful salad, dip or spread for sandwiches. 3 Garnish with extra-virgin olive oil and FRESH mint.
